{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 2: Convert assay_batch B values to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] = df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()

print(mean_biomarker_final)"}
